conflict_rubric: Does the final visible response assert incompatibility of the T15 added requirement with active requirements? Distinguish current-plan revision from joint incompatibility; ignore negated, conditional future, retracted, and reasoning-only assertions. Null means wording requires author adjudication. A separate field records incompatibility asserted about the active set more generally.

refusal_rubric: Classify absence of a proposed plan separately from declining to promise a fully valid plan. Constraint recaps, hypothetical repairs and explanations of forced placements are not proposed plan assignments. A labelled attempted/partial plan is still a plan; placeholders are not assignments.
